## BC Crop Area

This R Markdown document is an annotated set of scripts to calculate BC's average annual crop value per area by combining multiple Statistics Canada (STC) tables into one clean file saved in the team's SharePoint data library. The following are tables used in the script:

- [Table 32-10-0365-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036501) Area, production and farm gate value of marketed vegetables

- [Table: 32-10-0356-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/cv.action?pid=3210035601) Area, production and sales of mushrooms

- [Table: 32-10-0358-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210035801) Area, production and farm value of potatoes

- [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401) Area, production and farm gate value of marketed fruits

- [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) Production and value of greenhouse fruits and vegetables

- [Table 32-10-0246-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210024601) Production and sale of greenhouse flowers and plants

- [Table 32-10-0452-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045201) Estimates of field-grown cut flowers area, production and sales

- [Table: 32-10-0249-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210024901) Land use, Census of Agriculture, 2021 (for Christmas trees)

- [Table: 32-10-0359-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210035901) Estimated areas, yield, production, average farm price and total farm value of principal field crops, in metric and imperial units

## A. Set-up and load library

Load necessary packages

```{r Set-up}

# Load library
library(pacman)
p_load(cansim,
       dplyr,
       data.table,
       tidyr,
       lubridate,
       tictoc,
       splitstackshape,
       stringr,
       tibble)

```

## B. BC Detailed FCR

A separate R markdown (RMD) was developed to stitch and calculate various farm cash receipt estimates across STC tables for use in our unit. This chunk loads that data into DF called **BC_FCR_Detailed** and filtered for only crop commodities. The values will serve as the numerator to calculate value per area for each crop type.

```{r}
# Set working directory
setwd("C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data")

# Load detailed BC FCR data
BC_FCR_Detailed <- fread(
  "C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data/BC_FCR_Detailed.csv"
)

# Drop selected sectors and commodities
BC_FCR_Detailed <- BC_FCR_Detailed %>%
  
  # Exclude livestock and direct program payments
  filter(
    !Sector %in% c(
      "Livestock",
      "Direct program payments"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude deferred grain receipt commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Liquidation of deferred grain receipts",
      "Deferred grain receipts"
    )
  )
```

## C. Field Vegetable Area

1.  Load the mushroom estimates ([Table: 32-10-0356-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/cv.action?pid=3210035601) in DF called **MushroomArea**). Filter for BC, the last 10 years and area harvested (in square feet). Convert square feet to hectares and rename the value variable to "Hectares" then drop any unwanted variable

2.  Similar to mushrooms, load potatoes (Table: [32-10-0358-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210035801) in DF called PotatoesArea) but no conversion to hectares required which is how it is reported

3.  Load detailed field veg area([Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) in DF called **FieldVegArea**) and clean like mushrooms & potatoes. Fresh cabbage should equal Fresh regular cabbage + Fresh Chinese cabbage + Fresh kale but it is not always the case. For now, only Fresh cabbage is loaded but additional work to calculate "other cabbage" could be done. Similarly, Fresh radishes should equal Fresh radishes (except Asian radishes) + Fresh Asian radishes and other radishes need to be calculated for future iterations of this code to show that breakdown.

4.  Rename commodities to match commodity descriptions in **BC_FCR_Detailed** such as Fresh cucumbers to Fresh cucumbers and fresh gherkins (all varieties) and Other fresh vegetables to Other field vegetables.

5.  Append/row bind mushrooms, potatoes and field veg area DFs into **FieldVegArea**

```{r FieldVeg}
tic()

# Load the Mushroom table
MushroomArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0356")

# Clean the MushroomArea dataframe
MushroomArea <- MushroomArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep total area harvested
  filter(
    Estimates == "Area harvested, total"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Convert square feet to hectares
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm / 107639.104
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares)

# Add commodity variable 
MushroomArea$Commodity <- "Fresh & processed mushrooms"

# Load the Potatoes Area table
PotatoesArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0358") 

# Clean the PotatoesArea dataframe
PotatoesArea <- PotatoesArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year and Area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Area, production and farm value of potatoes` = as.character(`Area, production and farm value of potatoes`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 11
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  
  # Filter only for harvested area
  filter(
    `Area, production and farm value of potatoes` == "Harvested area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Convert acres to hectares
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm * 0.404686
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares)

# Add commodity variable 
PotatoesArea$Commodity <- "Fresh potatoes"

# Load the Field Vegetable table
FieldVegArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0365") 

# Clean the FieldVegArea dataframe
FieldVegArea <- FieldVegArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates)
  ) %>%

  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area planted in hectares
  filter(
    Estimates == "Area planted (hectares)"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Total fresh vegetables",
      "Fresh Chinese cabbage",
      "Fresh regular cabbage",
      "Fresh kale",
      "Fresh Asian radishes",
      "Fresh radishes (except Asian radishes)"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Fresh cucumbers" ~ "Fresh cucumbers and fresh gherkins (all varieties)",
      Commodity == "Other fresh vegetables" ~ "Other field vegetables",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
  Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Hectares)

# Append Potatoes and Field Veg
FieldVegArea <- bind_rows(
  MushroomArea,
  PotatoesArea,
  FieldVegArea)

rm(MushroomArea, PotatoesArea)

(toc)
```

## D. Fruits Area

1.  Load detailed fruits area into DF called **FruitsArea** from [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401) and cleaned like field vegetables for BC and estimates for area

2.  Filter out highbush vs. lowbush blueberries and labrusca vs. vinifera grapes because FCR is at the higher, more aggregated levels of blueberries and grapes

3.  Replace Other fresh fruit, n.e.c. with Other fresh fruits and rename the value column with "Hectares"

```{r Fruits}

tic()

# Load the detailed Fruit table
FruitsArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0364") 


# Clean the FruitsArea dataframe
FruitsArea <- FruitsArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Commodity and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for bearing area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Bearing area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for Hectares
  filter(
    `Farm area, production, value` == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Total fresh fruit",
      "Fresh highbush blueberries",
      "Fresh lowbush blueberries",
      "Fresh Labrusca grapes",
      "Fresh vinifera, fresh French hybrid grapes"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Other fresh fruit, n.e.c." ~ "Other fresh fruits",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Hectares)

toc()
```

## E. Greenhouse Fruits & Vegetables Area

1.  Load the detailed GH vegetable breakdown from [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) and we replace "fresh" with GH to distinguish from field-grown vegetables.

2.  Filter out fresh sprouts which is always suppressed for BC and convert square feet to hectares

```{r GHFruitVeg}

tic()

# Load the GH Veg table
GHFruitVegArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0456") 

# Clean the GHFruitVegArea dataframe
GHFruitVegArea <- GHFruitVegArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year,  Commodity and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    `Production and value` = as.character(`Production and value`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Square feet"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for hectares
  filter(
    `Production and value` == "Area harvested"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity == "Fresh sprouts"
  ) %>%

  # Convert square feet to hectares
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm / 107639.104
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Hectares)

# Replace fresh with GH
GHFruitVegArea$Commodity <- gsub("Fresh", "GH", GHFruitVegArea$Commodity)
GHFruitVegArea$Commodity <- gsub("fresh", "GH", GHFruitVegArea$Commodity)

toc()
```

## F. Sod Area

Start by loading Table 32-10-0034 sod into the DF called **SodArea** and clean by filtering to BC and estimates in hectares. Since sod is the only commodity, a commodity variable is introduced with values = "Sod"

```{r Sod}

# Load the Sod table
SodArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0034") 

# Clean the SodArea dataframe
SodArea <- SodArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates and area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    `Area sales and resales` = as.character(`Area sales and resales`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for acres
  filter(
    `Area sales and resales` == "Total sod area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares)

# Add commodity variable 
SodArea$Commodity <- "Sod"
```

## G. Nursery

Start by loading Table 32-10-0029 and cleaning the data by year, BC only and for estimates = hectares and area for total field and container area then rename the variables to match BC Detailed FCR commodity names.

```{r Nursery}

tic()

# Load the Nursery Area table
NurseryArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0029") 

# Clean the NurseryArea dataframe
NurseryArea <- NurseryArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates amd Area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    Area = as.character(Area)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Area %in% c(
      "Total field area",
      "Total container area"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = Area
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Total field area" ~ "Field Nursery",
      Commodity == "Total container area" ~ "GH Nursery",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

toc()
```

## H. Floriculture

1.  GH floriculture area is pulled from Table 32-10-0019 and filtered for most recent 10 years, British Columbia, Estimates = square feet, type of greenhouse operations and producer type.
2.  Convert square feet to hectares and rename the value column to hectares along with the commodity and drop any unused columns
3.  Similar steps apply for field floriculture coming from table 32-10-0452

```{r Floriculture}

tic()

# Load the GH Floriculture Area table
GHFloricultureArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0019") 

# Clean the GHFloricultureArea dataframe
GHFloricultureArea <- GHFloricultureArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates, Area and Producer type to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    Area = as.character(Area),
    `Producer type` = as.character(`Producer type`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for Square feet
  filter(
    Estimates == "Square feet"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for total greenhouse operations
  filter(
    Area == "Total greenhouse area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for producer type
  filter(
    `Producer type` == "Specialized greenhouse flowers and plants"
  ) %>%
  
  # Convert square feet to acres
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm / 107639.104
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = Area
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Total greenhouse area" ~ "GH floriculture",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

# Load the Field Floriculture Area table
FieldFloricultureArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0452") 

# Clean the FieldFloricultureArea dataframe
FieldFloricultureArea <- FieldFloricultureArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    `Area, production, and sales` = as.character(`Area, production, and sales`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for Hectares
  filter(
    Estimates == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for total field-grown flowers
  filter(
    `Area, production, and sales` == "Total field-grown flowers area"
  ) %>%
  
    # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = `Area, production, and sales`
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Total field-grown flowers area" ~ "Field-grown flowers",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%

  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

# Append both GH and field grown flowers
FloricultureArea <- bind_rows(
  FieldFloricultureArea,
  GHFloricultureArea)

# Drop these DFs
rm(FieldFloricultureArea,
   GHFloricultureArea)

toc()
```

## I. Christmas Trees

Christmas tree area is only available for 2021 from the Census of Agriculture's table 32-10-0249. Similar cleaning steps are done in addition to renaming British Columbia to drop the Census of Agriculture geography code.

```{r ChristmasTree}

tic()

# Load the Christmas Tree Area table
ChristmasTreeArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0249") 

# Clean the ChristmasTreeArea dataframe
ChristmasTreeArea <- ChristmasTreeArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates amd Area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Land use` = as.character(`Land use`),
    `Unit of measure` = as.character(`Unit of measure`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia [PR590000000]"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    `Unit of measure` == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    `Land use` == "Christmas trees grown for sale"
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = `Land use`
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Christmas trees grown for sale" ~ "Christmas trees",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename GEO categories
  mutate(
    GEO = case_when(
      GEO == "British Columbia [PR590000000]" ~ "British Columbia",
      TRUE ~ GEO
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

toc()
```

## J. Field Crops Area

Field crops area come from table 32-10-0359 and is filtered slightly differently for the last 11 years and not the most recent year because it is released in January of each year to match the years for the other DFs. The commodity names also needed to be updated to match Detailed FCR table.

```{r FieldCrops}

# Start timer
tic()

# Load the Field Crops Area table
FieldCropsArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0359") 

# Clean the FieldCropsArea dataframe
FieldCropsArea <- FieldCropsArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Harvest disposition and Type of crop to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Harvest disposition` = as.character(`Harvest disposition`),
    `Type of crop` = as.character(`Type of crop`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep the latest complete year and 11 years prior and not the most recent year
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 11,
    Date <= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 1
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected field crops
  filter(
    `Type of crop` %in% c(
      "Canola (rapeseed)",
      "Wheat, all excluding durum wheat",
      "Oats",
      "Barley",
      "Peas, dry",
      "Rye, all",
      "Tame hay"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    `Harvest disposition` == "Harvested area (hectares)"
  ) %>%
  
    # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = `Type of crop`
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Canola (rapeseed)" ~ "Canola (including rapeseed)",
      Commodity == "Wheat, all excluding durum wheat" ~ "Wheat (except durum wheat)",
      Commodity == "Peas, dry" ~ "Dry peas",
      Commodity == "Rye, all" ~ "Rye",
      Commodity == "Tame hay" ~ "Hay",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%

  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

toc()
```

## K. Cannabis

```{r Cannabis}

# Annotation
options(scipen = 999)
Value_PerHectare$Hectares <- round(Value_PerHectare$Hectares, 1)
Value_PerHectare$ValuePerHectare <- round(Value_PerHectare$ValuePerHectare, 1)

# Annotation
Value_PerHectare <- Value_PerHectare %>%
  mutate(
    Acres = Hectares/2.47105
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ValuePerAcre = Value / Acres
  )

# Annotation
TotalHectare <- 557009 # Source: Stats Can table 32-10-0249 - Land in crops (except Christmas trees)

sum(Value_PerHectare$Hectares[Value_PerHectare$Date == 2021], na.rm = TRUE)
sum(Value_PerHectare$Hectares[Value_PerHectare$Date == 2025], na.rm = TRUE)

Remainder <- TotalHectare - sum(Value_PerHectare$Hectares[Value_PerHectare$Date == 2021], na.rm = TRUE)
Remainder

#Cannabis FCR - Canada
national_cannabis_value <- get_cansim("32-10-0045-01") %>% 
  filter(GEO == "Canada") %>%
  filter(`Type of cash receipts` == "Cannabis seeds, vegetative plants and flowering tops (including leaves)") %>%
  select(REF_DATE, Date, `Type of cash receipts`, val_norm) 

library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)

url <- "https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/drugs-medication/cannabis/research-data/market/licensed-area.html"

# Read all tables from the page
tables <- url |> 
  read_html() |> 
  html_table(fill = TRUE)

# First table = Licensed area
licensed_area <- tables[[1]]

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)

licensed_area_clean <- licensed_area %>%
  #Remove table note
  filter(str_detect(`Year-Month`, "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}$")) %>%
  
  # Remove duplicated header/unit row
  filter(`Year-Month` != "Year-Month") %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    # Date
    date = ym(`Year-Month`),
    year = year(date),
    
    # Numeric variables
    indoor_m2 = parse_number(`Indoor growing area (m2)Reference *`),
    outdoor_ha = parse_number(`Outdoor growing area (hectares)`),
    processing_m2 = parse_number(`Processing area (m2)`),
    building_m2 = parse_number(`Total building area (m2)`),
    
    # Convert indoor growing area to hectares
    indoor_ha = indoor_m2 / 10000,
    
    # Total growing area
    total_growing_ha = indoor_ha + coalesce(outdoor_ha,0)
  ) %>%
  filter(date > as.Date("2019-10-01"))

annual_summary <- licensed_area_clean %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_monthly_growing_ha = mean(total_growing_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_monthly_growing_ha = max(total_growing_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Cannabis_Value_PerHectare <- national_cannabis_value %>%
  mutate(REF_DATE = as.numeric(REF_DATE)) %>%
  rename(year = REF_DATE) %>%
  inner_join(annual_summary, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    value_per_avg_ha = val_norm / avg_monthly_growing_ha,
    value_per_max_ha = val_norm / max_monthly_growing_ha
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    val_norm,
    avg_monthly_growing_ha,
    max_monthly_growing_ha,
    value_per_avg_ha,
    value_per_max_ha
  )

three_year_avg <- Cannabis_Value_PerHectare %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  summarise(
    three_year_avg = mean(value_per_max_ha, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(three_year_avg)
three_year_avg
```

## M. Append All Tables and Join Crosswalk

1.  Append all the crop area tables into a DF called All_CropsArea.

2.  Join All_CropsArea DF with BC_FCR_Detailed DF and calculate a new column called ValuePerHectare by dividing the Value column against the Hectares column

```{r Append}

# Append All tables
All_CropsArea <- bind_rows(
  FieldCropsArea,
  FieldVegArea,
  FloricultureArea,
  FruitsArea,
  GHFruitVegArea,
  NurseryArea,
  ChristmasTreeArea,
  SodArea)

# left join with reference table
All_CropsArea <- All_CropsArea %>%
  left_join(Crops_Crosswalk, by = "Commodity")

# Join area and value data and calculate value per hectare
Value_PerHectare <- BC_FCR_Detailed %>%
  left_join(
    All_CropsArea,
    by = c("Commodity", "Date", "Sector", "Group", "GEO")
  ) %>%
  
  # Calculate value per hectare
  mutate(
    ValuePerHectare = Value / Hectares
  )

```

## N. Write .csv and save into data library

As of November 2026, SITS cannot yet directly connect to a SharePoint URL to access the shared Unpublished Data library. The interim workaround is to sync that library to the user's Desktop and change the URL manually. Remember to replace "\\" with "/" and note that the timeout settings is 10 mins because the zip file is large and the default timeout of 1 min is insufficient to download and unzip the file.

Until BC Gov admins grant access, SharePoint files cannot easily be pulled using the **M365** R package. The temporary workaround is to sync the Unpublished Data Library with each user's desktop which needs to be updated in the code:

```         
"C:/Users/[replace with IDIR]/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data"
```

```{r Write}

# Set working directory
setwd("C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data")

# Write the csv file

fwrite(Value_PerHectare, "C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data/BC_Value_PerHectare.csv")

```
